payload.core_composition_summary: Interval DP precomputes subarray collapsibility, then 1D DP uses that to compute minimal length.
payload.rationale: Solution first runs interval DP to determine if any subarray can be collapsed into one element, then runs a separate 1D DP over prefixes to combine these collapsible segments optimally.
